review: 707.9a-1: the turn passes through B's draw step with both libraries empty, so B would lose; gave A and B two-card libraries.
707.7-1: Banisher Priest has a single exile-until ability (610.3), not a linked pair, so it did not exercise 707.7; swapped in Fiend Hunter, whose two abilities are linked (607.2a).
707.9b-1: base expected said Clone 'targets' the Copy Artifact; Clone chooses, it does not target; reworded.
707.10a-1: had no does_not_fire variant; made countering the copy the base and added a variant countering the original card, which goes to the graveyard, keeping the uncountered case as 'other'.
707.10g-1: the turn passes through B's draw step with B's library empty, so B would lose; gave B a two-card library.

707.11-1: once the Shapeshifter became Ambush Viper the ability's damage came from a deathtouch source, so Centaur Courser would die, contradicting the expected; swapped Ambush Viper for the vanilla flash Ashcoat Bear (3/3 with the counter).
707.14-1: the turn passes to A's draw step with A's library empty, so A would lose; gave A a two-card library.

scenarios.title: A copy takes copiable values but not counters or other effects

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is a plain 2/2 in the base setup.

decisions: A casts Clone, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; Clone resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone enters as a green 2/2 named Grizzly Bears; the original Grizzly Bears is a 2/2.

variants.label: counter
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has a +1/+1 counter on it before Clone is cast.
variants.expected: The original Grizzly Bears is a 3/3 with a +1/+1 counter; the Clone enters as a 2/2 named Grizzly Bears with no counter.

variants.label: giant_growth
variants.delta: In response to Clone, B casts Giant Growth on Grizzly Bears (tapping Forest) and it resolves first.
variants.expected: The original Grizzly Bears is a 5/5 until end of turn; the Clone enters as a 2/2 named Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.title: A copy of an animated artifact does not copy the type change

setup.notes: Chimeric Staff is untapped and not animated at the start.

decisions: A activates Chimeric Staff with X=1, tapping an Island; it resolves and Chimeric Staff is a 1/1 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; it resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Chimeric Staff.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone enters as a noncreature artifact named Chimeric Staff that is not a creature; the original Chimeric Staff is still a 1/1 Construct artifact creature.

variants.label: activate_copy
variants.delta: After Clone has entered, A activates the copy's ability with X=1, tapping the sixth Island.
variants.expected: The copy has Chimeric Staff's ability and becomes a 1/1 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Clone can only choose a creature, so the Staff is animated first; Forge may not offer a noncreature copy target after the animation ends.

scenarios.title: A copy acquires the original's color and exactly one set of its abilities
decisions: A casts Clone, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; Clone resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Wall of Omens.
The copied enters trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone is a white 0/4 Wall named Wall of Omens with defender; A drew exactly one card, so A's hand has one card.

variants.label: bears
variants.delta: A chooses Grizzly Bears instead of Wall of Omens.
variants.expected: Clone is a green 2/2 named Grizzly Bears without defender; A drew no card.

scenarios.title: Turning the original face up does not change a copy of it
decisions: A casts Gathan Raiders face down for {3}, tapping three Mountains; it resolves as a 2/2 face-down creature.
A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; it resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of the face-down creature.
A turns the face-down creature face up by paying its morph cost, discarding the Mountain.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Gathan Raiders is face up as a 5/5 (hellbent, no cards in hand); Clone is still a colorless 2/2 with no name, no types and no abilities.

variants.label: stays_face_down
variants.delta: A does not turn the creature face up.
variants.expected: Gathan Raiders is a face-down 2/2 and Clone is a colorless 2/2 with no name; A keeps the Mountain in hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Clone may or may not keep the face-down characteristics; 707.2 gives a copy of a face-down permanent the face-down values.

scenarios.title: A static copy effect fixes its copiable values when it first applies
decisions: A casts Gathan Raiders face down for {3}, tapping three Mountains; it resolves as a 2/2 face-down creature.
A casts Metamorphic Alteration, tapping two Islands, enchanting Runeclaw Bear; as it enters A chooses the face-down creature.
A turns the face-down creature face up by paying its morph cost, discarding the Mountain.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Gathan Raiders is a face-up 5/5 (hellbent); the enchanted creature is still a colorless 2/2 with no name.

variants.label: stays_face_down
variants.delta: A does not turn the creature face up.
variants.expected: Gathan Raiders is a face-down 2/2 and the enchanted creature is a colorless 2/2 with no name; A keeps the Mountain in hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Metamorphic Alteration is the static copy effect; choosing a face-down creature depends on Forge's ChooseCard accepting it.

scenarios.title: A copy of a copy takes the first copy's copiable values
decisions: A casts Vesuvan Doppelganger, tapping five Islands; as it enters A chooses to copy Runeclaw Bear.
A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; as it enters A chooses to copy the Vesuvan Doppelganger (a copy of Runeclaw Bear).

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone is a blue 2/2 Bear named Runeclaw Bear that has Vesuvan Doppelganger's upkeep ability.

variants.label: direct
variants.delta: A has Clone copy B's Runeclaw Bear instead of the Doppelganger.
variants.expected: Clone is a green 2/2 Bear named Runeclaw Bear with no abilities.

scenarios.forge_notes: The face-down-becomes-a-copy part of 707.3 is not exercised here.

scenarios.title: An ability a copy effect grants is copied by a later copy

setup.notes: Both libraries hold cards so neither player loses to an empty-library draw while the turn passes.

decisions: A casts Vesuvan Doppelganger, tapping five Islands; as it enters A chooses to copy Runeclaw Bear.
A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; as it enters A chooses to copy the Vesuvan Doppelganger.
The turn passes to B and back to A with no further actions.
In A's upkeep each upkeep trigger on the stack resolves and A declines to become a copy.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Two upkeep triggers are put on the stack, one from the Doppelganger and one from the Clone.

variants.label: direct
variants.delta: A had Clone copy B's Runeclaw Bear instead of the Doppelganger.
variants.expected: One upkeep trigger is put on the stack, from the Doppelganger only; the Clone has no abilities.

scenarios.title: Becoming a copy while on the battlefield triggers no enters ability and keeps other effects
decisions: A casts Giant Growth on Unstable Shapeshifter, tapping Forest; it resolves.
A casts Wall of Omens, tapping two Plains; it resolves.
Wall of Omens' enters trigger and Unstable Shapeshifter's trigger both resolve; the Shapeshifter becomes a copy of Wall of Omens.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Unstable Shapeshifter is a 3/7 Wall named Wall of Omens (0/4 plus 3/3 from Giant Growth); A drew exactly one card, from the real Wall.

variants.label: no_growth
variants.delta: A does not cast Giant Growth.
variants.expected: Unstable Shapeshifter is a 0/4 Wall named Wall of Omens; A drew exactly one card.

scenarios.title: A permanent entering as a copy applies the copied enters replacement effects
decisions: A casts Clone, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; Clone resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Skyshroud Behemoth.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone enters as a 10/10 Skyshroud Behemoth that is tapped and has two fade counters.

variants.label: bear
variants.delta: A chooses Runeclaw Bear instead.
variants.expected: Clone enters as an untapped 2/2 Runeclaw Bear with no counters.

scenarios.title: A permanent entering as a copy triggers the copied enters ability
decisions: A casts Clone, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; Clone resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Wall of Omens.
Both players pass; the enters trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone's copied enters trigger fires and A draws one card; A's hand has one card.

variants.label: bear
variants.delta: A chooses Runeclaw Bear instead.
variants.expected: No enters trigger fires; A's hand is empty.

scenarios.title: A copy makes its own as-enters choice
decisions: A casts Adaptive Automaton, tapping three Islands; as it enters A chooses Bear.
A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; as it enters A chooses to copy Adaptive Automaton and chooses Goblin.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear is a 3/3 (pumped by the Automaton only), Raging Goblin is a 2/2 (pumped by the Clone only), the Automaton is a 2/2 and the Clone is a 2/2.

variants.label: same_choice
variants.delta: A chooses Bear for the Clone instead of Goblin.
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear is a 4/4, Raging Goblin is a 1/1, the Automaton is a 3/3 and the Clone is a 3/3.

scenarios.title: Copied linked abilities are linked only to each other on the copy
decisions: A casts Fiend Hunter, tapping three Plains; its enters trigger targets Grizzly Bears and A chooses to exile it.
A casts Clone, tapping Island and three Plains; as it enters A chooses to copy Fiend Hunter, and its copied enters trigger targets Centaur Courser and A chooses to exile it.
B casts Lightning Bolt, tapping Mountain, targeting the permanent named in the variant; it resolves and the leaves-the-battlefield trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B targets the original Fiend Hunter: it dies, Grizzly Bears returns to the battlefield, and Centaur Courser stays in exile.

variants.label: clone_dies
variants.delta: B targets the Clone instead.
variants.expected: The Clone (a 1/3 Fiend Hunter) dies, Centaur Courser returns to the battlefield, and Grizzly Bears stays in exile.

scenarios.title: A copy uses the face that is up

setup.notes: The first library card is the top card.

decisions: In A's upkeep Delver of Secrets' trigger resolves; A looks at the top card and reveals it if it is an instant or sorcery.
After the draw step, in main phase 1 A casts Clone, tapping four Islands, and chooses to have it enter as a copy of Delver of Secrets.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The top card Lightning Bolt is revealed and Delver transforms; Clone enters as a blue 3/2 flying Human Insect named Insectile Aberration.

variants.label: no_flip
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is an Island.
variants.expected: Delver stays front face up; Clone enters as a blue 1/1 Human Wizard named Delver of Secrets.

scenarios.forge_notes: The Island variant replaces the top library card Lightning Bolt with Island.

scenarios.title: A token copy of a double-faced permanent has both faces and keeps the face up

setup.notes: The first library card is the top card.

decisions: In A's upkeep Delver of Secrets' trigger resolves; A looks at the top card and reveals it if it is an instant or sorcery.
After the draw step, in main phase 1 A casts Cackling Counterpart, tapping three Islands, targeting Delver of Secrets; it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Delver is transformed; the token enters back face up as a blue 3/2 flying Insectile Aberration, and it is a double-faced token whose other face is Delver of Secrets.

variants.label: front_up
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is an Island, so Delver stays front face up.
variants.expected: The token enters front face up as a blue 1/1 Delver of Secrets, and it is a double-faced token whose other face is Insectile Aberration.

scenarios.title: A characteristic modified by a copy effect stays in the copiable values
decisions: A casts Copy Artifact, tapping two Islands; as it enters A chooses to copy Juggernaut; it is an enchantment in addition to its other types.
A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; as it enters A chooses the permanent named in the variant.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Clone copies the Copy Artifact: Clone is a 5/3 Juggernaut that is an artifact, creature and enchantment.

variants.label: original
variants.delta: A has Clone copy the original Juggernaut.
variants.expected: Clone is a 5/3 Juggernaut that is an artifact and a creature, not an enchantment.

scenarios.title: A characteristic a copy effect does not copy keeps its original value
decisions: A casts Vesuvan Doppelganger, tapping five Islands.
It resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: doppelganger
variants.expected: The Doppelganger is a blue 2/2 Bear named Grizzly Bears; its color was not copied.

variants.label: clone
variants.delta: A casts Clone (tapping four Islands) instead of Vesuvan Doppelganger.
variants.expected: Clone is a green 2/2 named Grizzly Bears; its color was copied.

scenarios.title: A copy that sets power and toughness does not copy the characteristic-defining ability

setup.notes: Tarmogoyf is a 2/3 (instant and creature in graveyards).

decisions: A casts Quicksilver Gargantuan, tapping seven Islands.
It resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Tarmogoyf.

variants.label: gargantuan
variants.expected: The Gargantuan is a 7/7 Lhurgoyf named Tarmogoyf without the characteristic-defining ability, so it stays 7/7.

variants.label: clone
variants.delta: A casts Clone (tapping four Islands) instead of Quicksilver Gargantuan.
variants.expected: Clone is a Tarmogoyf with the characteristic-defining ability and is a 2/3 (instant and creature in graveyards).

scenarios.title: An in-addition type exception still copies a characteristic-defining type ability
decisions: A casts Glasspool Mimic, tapping three Islands.
It resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of Changeling Outcast.

variants.label: outcast
variants.expected: The Mimic has changeling and every creature type, so Goblin King gives it +1/+1: it is a 2/2.

variants.label: spirit
variants.delta: A chooses Wandering Ones instead of Changeling Outcast.
variants.expected: The Mimic is a Spirit, Shapeshifter and Rogue only, receives no bonus and is a 1/1.

scenarios.title: A copy effect's additional-effect exception is lost if another copy effect applies

setup.notes: Glorious Anthem keeps an uncopied 0/0 Clone alive as a 1/1.

decisions: A casts Clone, tapping four Islands; it resolves and A chooses not to copy anything, so it enters as a 1/1 with the anthem.
A casts Altered Ego with X=2, tapping five Islands and Forest; as it enters A chooses to copy the Clone, then applies the replacement effect gained from Clone and chooses Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: via_clone
variants.expected: Altered Ego is a Grizzly Bears 3/3 (2/2 plus anthem) with no +1/+1 counters.

variants.label: direct
variants.delta: Altered Ego enters as a copy of Grizzly Bears directly instead of the Clone.
variants.expected: Altered Ego enters with two +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may not model applying a second copy effect to a copy of Clone; the Clone card is the unusual part.

scenarios.title: A conditional copy exception applies only if the result has the stated characteristic
decisions: A pays {1} with a Forest to animate Mutavault; it is a 2/2 creature until end of turn.
A casts Moritte of the Frost, tapping three Islands and two Forests.
It resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of the animated Mutavault.

variants.label: mutavault
variants.expected: Moritte enters as a legendary snow land named Mutavault that is not a creature: no +1/+1 counters and no changeling.

variants.label: bears
variants.delta: A chooses Grizzly Bears instead of Mutavault.
variants.expected: Moritte enters as a legendary snow Bear creature with two +1/+1 counters and changeling: a 4/4.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge checks the creature condition on the entering card, which may differ for a copied animated land.

scenarios.title: A triggered ability linked to a copy-effect replacement does not trigger after a second copy effect
decisions: A casts Superior Spider-Man, tapping four lands.
It resolves and A chooses to have it enter as a copy of the Clone card in A's graveyard, then applies the replacement effect gained from Clone and chooses Hill Giant.

variants.label: via_clone
variants.expected: Spider-Man ends as a 3/3 Hill Giant and the linked exile trigger does not trigger: Clone stays in A's graveyard.

variants.label: bears_card
variants.delta: A chooses the Grizzly Bears card instead of the Clone card (no second copy effect).
variants.expected: Spider-Man enters as a 4/4 named Superior Spider-Man and the linked trigger exiles Grizzly Bears from A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Spider-Man script may exile the Clone card regardless.

scenarios.title: A spell copy keeps the objects used to pay the original's costs
decisions: A casts Fling, sacrificing Grizzly Bears and tapping two Mountains, targeting B.
With Fling on the stack A casts Reverberate, tapping two Mountains, targeting Fling.
Reverberate resolves; A keeps the same target for the copy; the copy and Fling resolve.

variants.label: bears
variants.expected: The copy of Fling deals 2 damage and Fling deals 2 damage: B is at 16.

variants.label: wurm
variants.delta: A sacrifices Craw Wurm (power 6) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The copy deals 6 and Fling deals 6: B is at 8.

variants.label: no_copy
variants.delta: A does not cast Reverberate.
variants.expected: Only Fling deals 2 damage: B is at 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: Both creatures are on the battlefield in the setup; the variant picks which is sacrificed.

scenarios.title: A copy of a spell does not carry the mana spent on the original
decisions: A casts Dawnglow Infusion with X=1, paying X with Plains and the hybrid cost with Forest, so {W} and {G} were spent.
In the variant with Twincast, A casts it with two Islands targeting Dawnglow Infusion; the copy resolves first.
Dawnglow Infusion resolves.

variants.label: no_copy
variants.expected: A gains 2 life (1 for {G}, 1 for {W}): A is at 22.

variants.label: copy
variants.delta: A casts Twincast to copy Dawnglow Infusion.
variants.expected: The copy gains A no life because no mana was spent on it; the original gains 2: A is at 22.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may count the original's spent mana for the copy.

scenarios.title: A copy of a spell is a spell but is not cast
decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping a Mountain; Young Pyromancer's trigger resolves.
With Shock on the stack A casts Dualcaster Mage (flash), tapping three Mountains; its enters trigger copies Shock, keeping the target B.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: dualcaster
variants.expected: Young Pyromancer triggered once only (for the cast Shock): A has one Elemental token; B took 2 from Shock and 2 from the copy and is at 16.

variants.label: second_shock
variants.delta: A casts a second Shock targeting B (tapping a Mountain) instead of Dualcaster Mage.
variants.expected: Young Pyromancer triggered for both casts: A has two Elemental tokens; B is at 16.

scenarios.title: A copy of a spell ceases to exist outside the stack
decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping a Mountain.
A casts Reverberate targeting Shock, tapping two Mountains; it resolves and creates a copy of Shock with the same target.
B casts Counterspell targeting the copy of Shock, tapping two Islands.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: counter_copy
variants.expected: The copy of Shock is countered and ceases to exist without moving to a graveyard; Shock deals 2 damage: B is at 18. A's graveyard holds Shock and Reverberate only; B's holds Counterspell.

variants.label: counter_original
variants.delta: B's Counterspell targets the original Shock instead of the copy.
variants.expected: The Shock card is countered and moves to A's graveyard; the copy resolves, deals 2 damage and ceases to exist: B is at 18. A's graveyard holds Shock and Reverberate; B's holds Counterspell.

variants.label: no_counter
variants.delta: B does not cast Counterspell.
variants.expected: The copy resolves for 2 damage and ceases to exist; Shock deals 2: B is at 16. A's graveyard holds Shock and Reverberate only.

scenarios.title: A copy of an ability has the same source as the original
decisions: A activates Olivia Voldaren's first ability targeting Centaur Courser, tapping two Mountains.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; A pays {2} with the other two Mountains and keeps the target for the copy.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: pay
variants.expected: Centaur Courser has 2 damage marked and is a Vampire; both resolutions put their +1/+1 counter on Olivia Voldaren herself: she has two counters and is a 5/5.

variants.label: decline
variants.delta: A declines to pay {2} for Rings of Brighthearth.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser has 1 damage marked and is a Vampire; Olivia has one counter and is a 4/4.

scenarios.title: A copy may keep an illegal target but new targets must be legal
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping a Mountain.
B casts Gods Willing targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains, choosing protection from red; it resolves, making Shock's target illegal.
A casts Reverberate targeting Shock, tapping two Mountains; it resolves and A leaves the copy's target unchanged.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: keep
variants.expected: The copy is put on the stack targeting the illegal Grizzly Bears and fizzles; Shock fizzles; Grizzly Bears has no damage; B is at 20.

variants.label: retarget
variants.delta: A changes the copy's target to B (a legal target) instead of leaving it unchanged.
variants.expected: The copy deals 2 damage to B: B is at 18; Shock fizzles; Grizzly Bears has no damage.

scenarios.title: A copy is made for each permanent or player the spell could target
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping a Mountain.
A casts Radiate targeting Shock, tapping five Mountains; it resolves, putting a copy of Shock on the stack for each other permanent or player Shock could target, each targeting a different one.
All copies and Shock resolve.

variants.label: gargoyles
variants.expected: B's battlefield is Grizzly Bears and Abbey Gargoyles. Copies target A and B only, not the protected Abbey Gargoyles: A is at 18, B is at 18, Grizzly Bears is dead and Abbey Gargoyles has no damage.

variants.label: hill_giant
variants.delta: Hill Giant replaces Abbey Gargoyles on B's battlefield.
variants.expected: A copy also targets Hill Giant: it has 2 damage marked; A is at 18, B is at 18, Grizzly Bears is dead.

scenarios.title: A copy with a specified new target is made only if that target is legal
decisions: A casts Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest.
Frontline Heroism triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier token and then trying to copy the spell with the copy targeting that token.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: giant_growth
variants.expected: The copy is created targeting the Soldier token: the token is a 4/4 and Grizzly Bears is a 5/5 until end of turn.

variants.label: unexpected_allies
variants.delta: A casts Unexpected Allies (nontoken creature only), tapping two Mountains, instead of Giant Growth.
variants.expected: The token is not a legal target, so no copy is created: the token is a 1/1 and Grizzly Bears is a 4/2 with double team until end of turn.

scenarios.title: A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token as it resolves
decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping two Forests.
With it on the stack A activates Lithoform Engine's third ability ({4}, {T}) targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping four Forests; the copy goes on the stack.
If the variant says so, B casts Counterspell targeting the copy, tapping two Islands.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: A controls a Grizzly Bears card and a Grizzly Bears token.

variants.label: copy_countered
variants.delta: B counters the copy with Counterspell.
variants.expected: A controls only the Grizzly Bears card; no token exists and the copy is not in any graveyard.

scenarios.title: A copy of a double-faced permanent spell becomes a double-faced token

setup.notes: The first library card is the top card. B's library holds cards so B does not lose in its draw step.

decisions: A casts Delver of Secrets, tapping an Island.
With it on the stack A activates Lithoform Engine's third ability ({4}, {T}) targeting Delver, tapping four Islands; the copy goes on the stack.
All objects on the stack resolve; both are 1/1 Delvers.
The turn passes to B and back to A; in A's upkeep both Delver of Secrets triggers resolve and A reveals the top card.

variants.label: flips
variants.expected: Both Delvers transform; the token is a double-faced token and becomes a blue 3/2 flying Insectile Aberration, as does the card.

variants.label: land_on_top
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is an Island.
variants.expected: Nothing transforms; the token and the card are both 1/1 Delver of Secrets.

scenarios.title: An effect that refers to a permanent by name still tracks it after it changes
decisions: B casts Olivia Voldaren, tapping four lands; Unstable Shapeshifter triggers and becomes a copy of Olivia Voldaren. B passes priority.
A activates the copied ability ({1}{R}) targeting Centaur Courser, tapping two Mountains.
In the base variant A then casts Ashcoat Bear (flash) in response, tapping two Forests; it resolves and the Shapeshifter's trigger turns it into a copy of Ashcoat Bear.
The activated ability resolves.

variants.label: changes_again
variants.expected: Centaur Courser has 1 damage marked and is a Vampire; the +1/+1 counter lands on the same permanent, now a 3/3 Ashcoat Bear.

variants.label: stays_olivia
variants.delta: A does not cast Ashcoat Bear.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser has 1 damage marked and is a Vampire; the permanent is still a copy of Olivia Voldaren and is a 4/4 with a +1/+1 counter.

scenarios.title: A copy created by name is cast, can be countered, and ceases to exist afterwards

setup.notes: No Disenchant is in any of A's zones.

decisions: A activates Garth One-Eye ({T}) and chooses the name Disenchant; the copy is created from the Oracle characteristics.
A casts the copy targeting Juggernaut, tapping two Plains.
All objects on the stack resolve.

variants.label: cast
variants.expected: The copy resolves and Juggernaut is destroyed and goes to B's graveyard; the copy ceases to exist and A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: decline
variants.delta: A does not cast the copy.
variants.expected: Juggernaut stays on the battlefield; the copy ceases to exist; A's Plains stay untapped.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell targeting the copy, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: The copy is countered and ceases to exist instead of going to a graveyard; Juggernaut stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A copy of a noted card uses its characteristics as in the graveyard

setup.notes: A's library holds cards so A does not lose in its draw step.

decisions: In B's end step A activates Magar's ability ({1}{B}{R}) targeting Lightning Bolt in A's graveyard; it resolves and Lightning Bolt enters face down as a 3/3 creature.
The turn passes to A; A attacks B with the face-down creature.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.
If the face-down creature dealt combat damage to B, its trigger resolves and A creates a copy of Lightning Bolt, casting it without paying its mana cost, targeting B.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: The creature deals 3 combat damage and the copy of Lightning Bolt deals 3 more: B is at 14.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks with Grizzly Bears instead of declaring no blockers.
variants.expected: No combat damage reaches B so nothing triggers: B is at 20; Grizzly Bears dies and the face-down creature survives with 2 damage.

scenarios.forge_notes: The setup starts in B's end step; the Magar activation is the first decision.
